meta.promptText: Mujhe aisa sunscreen kharidna hai jo Indian skin par white cast na chhode. Konsa best hai?

response.text:
**Best overall:** **Minimalist Light Fluid SPF 50 PA++++** — lightweight, fragrance-free aur Indian skin tones par generally white cast nahi chhodta. Oily/combination skin ke liye iska finish comfortable rehta hai. Chemical sunscreens mein white cast ka chance mineral sunscreens se kam hota hai.[1][2]

Aap apni skin type ke hisaab se ye options bhi dekh sakte hain:

- **Oily skin:** **Neutrogena Ultra Sheer Dry-Touch SPF 50+** — lightweight aur water-resistant; lekin alcohol ki wajah se very dry ya sensitive skin ko irritate kar sakta hai.[3]
- **Dry/normal skin:** **PHD Panthenol Hydrating Gel SPF 60 PA++++** — hydrating gel texture aur no-white-cast finish.[4]
- **Tinted option:** **Lakmé Sun Expert Tinted Sunscreen SPF 50** — tint ki wajah se white cast hide hota hai aur most Indian skin tones par blend ho jata hai.[5]
- **Budget option:** **Plum SPF 50 PA++++ Sunscreen** — lightweight, no-white-cast formula ke roop mein listed hai.[6]

**Meri short recommendation:** Pehle **Minimalist Light Fluid SPF 50 PA++++** try karein. Face aur neck ke liye **do-finger quantity** lagayein, aur bahar rehne par lagbhag har 2 ghante mein reapply karein.[4] Mineral sunscreen—jisme zinc oxide ya titanium dioxide ho—medium-to-deep skin tones par cast chhod sakta hai, isliye “chemical” ya mostly chemical-filter formula choose karein.[2]
